task:
Shotcut is already open with /home/user/Documents/layered.mlt (1920x1080 30 fps, empty timeline). Four source files exist: /home/user/Videos/bg.mp4, /home/user/Videos/overlay.mp4, /home/user/Music/music.mp3, and /home/user/Music/voiceover.mp3.

Import all four media files. Place bg.mp4 on video track V1, overlay.mp4 on a second video track V2, music.mp3 on audio track A1, and voiceover.mp3 on audio track A2. Save the project.

verification.description: Timeline tractor has at least 5 track references (bin + V1 + V2 + A1 + A2)

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CLI: project open layered.mlt, timeline add-track --type video --name V2, timeline add-track --type audio --name A1, timeline add-track --type audio --name A2, timeline add-clip bg.mp4 --track 1, timeline add-clip overlay.mp4 --track 2, timeline add-clip music.mp3 --track 3, timeline add-clip voiceover.mp3 --track 4, project save
cli_feasibility.reason: ✅ Fully supported by CLI-Anything shotcut skills: project open, timeline add-track (3 tracks), timeline add-clip (4 clips across tracks), project save. Complex multi-track layered compositing workflow.
